title: ZCC service entitlement: who gets Private Access and ZDX

subjects.title: ZCC service entitlement: who gets Private Access and ZDX
subjects.lead: Service entitlement selects which user groups or device groups can enroll into Private Access (ZPA), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Deception; Internet...

subjects.title: Digital Experience (ZDX) entitlement
subjects.lead: With ZDX Enabled by Default on, ZDX is available to all users and cannot be assigned to a group or device group.

subjects.title: Private Access entitlement and the machine tunnel switch
subjects.lead: With ZPA Enabled by Default for User Tunnel on, Private Access is available to all users and cannot be assigned to a group.
